why: d2 is the later delivery of the four newest originals that change what a seller says: the Endive release notes (Sep-Oct 2026) and the full API changelog carrying Endive and Dahlia changes, the Accounts v2 page that replaces the connected-account-type model, and the sub-processor list updated 27 September 2026 (Microsoft Azure and Snowflake added, Stripe, Inc. removed). d1 stands on its own: it already has the versioning page naming 2026-10-28.endive as current, the deprecated account-types page and the Connect hub pointing to Accounts v2, and the DPA for sub-processor terms.
